Sub:- Implementation

Implementation

is a mandatory

under

Document

under

Reforms". The standards for achieving the ISO9001 certification
are to be so laid down that
the 'service capability'
of EPFOis strengthened
and standardized across all its offices.
A pilot project was done at SROJabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, after which SRO Jabalpur has received
the said certificate.

the ISO certification
